# Anahana

> Anahana is a global leader in mental health and wellness education, offering comprehensive resources on meditation, yoga, breathing techniques, and spiritual guidance.

Anahana provides evidence-based wellness education across multiple languages and platforms, including the Nema spiritual growth platform. The site covers physical health, mental wellness, lifestyle practices, and spiritual topics through interactive guides, blogs, and email courses.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health
- Meditation
- Yoga
- Breathing Exercises
- Mindfulness
- Chakras
- Wellness Education
- Pilates
- Tarot
- Angel Numbers
- Numerology
- Astrology
- Spiritual Guidance
- Healthy Lifestyle
- Physical Health

## Core Wellness & Mental Health

- [Anahana - Wellbeing for Life](https://www.anahana.com): Global leader in mental health and wellness education
- [Mental Health Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/mental-health): Mental health research and techniques for stress relief and emotional wellness
- [Physical Health Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/physical-health): Physical health guide covering sleep, fitness, posture, and nervous system
- [Healthy Lifestyle Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/healthy-lifestyle): Healthy lifestyle skills and routines for balanced living and stress reduction

## Mindfulness & Meditation Practices

- [Meditation Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/meditation): Meditation guide covering techniques, mindfulness, and stress relief practices
- [Yoga Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/yoga): Yoga resources and guides covering poses, breathing, chakras, and fundamentals
- [Breathing Exercise Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/breathing-exercise): Breathing exercise techniques including Wim Hof and Buteyko methods
- [Pilates Wiki](https://www.anahana.com/en/pilates): Pilates resources and information on methods, equipment, and health benefits

## Spiritual Guidance & Numerology

- [Nema by Anahana](https://nema.anahana.com): Spiritual growth platform covering angel numbers, tarot, and astrology
- [Angel Numbers Directory](https://www.anahana.com/en/angel-numbers): Comprehensive angel numbers directory with meanings and numerology guidance
- [Life Path Numbers](https://www.anahana.com/en/life-path-numbers): Life path numbers guide covering numerology, personality, and life purpose
- [Tarot Guide](https://www.anahana.com/en/tarot): Tarot guide with card meanings, spreads, readings, and interpretation tips

## Astrology & Personality Insights

- [Zodiac Signs Guide](https://www.anahana.com/en/zodiac): Zodiac signs guide with traits, compatibility, and astrological insights
- [Chinese Zodiac](https://www.anahana.com/en/chinese-zodiac): Chinese zodiac guide with animal traits, meanings, and personality associations
- [Crystals & Stones Directory](https://www.anahana.com/en/crystals): Comprehensive crystal and stone directory with healing properties and meanings

## Learning Resources & Blog

- [Wellbeing Blog](https://www.anahana.com/en/wellbeing-blog): Health and wellness blog with tips, how-tos, and resources on yoga and mindfulness
- [Free Email Guides Library](https://www.anahana.com/email-courses): Library of free email guides on breathing, chakras, yoga nidra, and wellness
